purpose: Classify every intentional dynamic leaf in the Deck-facing API contract.

classifications.reason: Activity stream events carry upstream event fields beyond the stable agentId/type pair.
classifications.exitCriteria: Replace with event-specific DTOs when activity stream payload schemas are productized.

classifications.reason: Agent cognition writes carry OpenClaw memory search config fragments whose nested keys are Gateway-owned.

classifications.reason: Agent delivery writes carry OpenClaw heartbeat config fragments whose nested keys are Gateway-owned.
classifications.exitCriteria: Narrow when OpenClaw publishes a stable heartbeat config schema.

classifications.reason: Effective inheritance fields expose computed values whose shape depends on the referenced OpenClaw config bucket.

classifications.reason: Health snapshots preserve Gateway diagnostic fields not yet modeled as product KPIs.

classifications.reason: Per-agent health details are passed through from Gateway health/status data.
classifications.exitCriteria: Replace with named agent health DTOs when the product view fixes the required metrics.

classifications.reason: Impact previews accept a proposed OpenClaw config fragment for the operation being analyzed.
classifications.exitCriteria: Replace with operation-specific proposed DTOs if impact preview supports field-level mutation forms.

classifications.reason: Impact risk messages use locale keys with optional template variables; variable shape depends on the operation-specific copy.
classifications.exitCriteria: Replace with operation-specific risk DTOs if risk copy becomes a structured product model.

classifications.reason: Binding peer descriptors mirror channel-specific Gateway routing metadata.
classifications.exitCriteria: Narrow when routing binding peer metadata has a stable Deck product DTO.

classifications.reason: Product action responses may echo bucket-specific OpenClaw config fragments after guarded writes.
classifications.exitCriteria: Replace with bucket-specific response DTOs if the frontend needs field-specific rendering.

classifications.reason: Raw agent config exposes editable OpenClaw config fragments.
classifications.exitCriteria: Remove from the product surface or type field-by-field when raw config editing is redesigned.

classifications.reason: Compaction action responses vary by action and currently share a broad result envelope.
